desc: TORCHWOOD stage0: compact canonical squat brown hollow stump with chunky charred bark ridges, small natural flared wood roots and jagged cut top. Tall warm orange/yellow fire above, pale-yellow hot interior. Friendly carved wood face, alert kind amber eyes and toothy smile. Simple clean bark knots, not lots of extra branches. Actual original-game identity in our pixel style.

BLAZE WOOD stage1: natural grown extension of canonical Torchwood. A taller sturdier dark-brown HOLLOW TREE TRUNK with deeper carved bark grain and a couple small gnarled branch KNOT STUBS kept close against sides (NOT arms). Broader stronger root flare and jagged cut rim. A stronger taller ORANGE/YELLOW attached flame crown with pale cream inner core. Friendly amber eyes and broad toothy carved wood grin, not angry. More detailed but recognizable burning stump, no metal armor or supernatural monster body.

INFERNO WOOD stage2: final natural Torchwood evolution: broad massive CHARRED BROWN hollow trunk with dark bark furrows, rugged knotted texture, jagged pale cut rim and wide strong natural root flare. Small broken branch stubs tightly integrated with bark, never gesturing like arms. Wide BLAZING ATTACHED ORANGE/YELLOW flame crown containing a small clearly BLUE-WHITE HOT CORE near its base, as project progression requires. Keep orange outer fire to remain recognizably Torchwood; blue-white interior is restrained, not an entirely blue elemental body. Friendly strong amber-eyed carved face and toothy grin, no mad/evil brow. Strongest tree silhouette but no king crown, armor or floating aura.
